result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, mostly first-person plural with 'we believe' framing. Innovation and technology lead as the headline value, with D&I and COVID-19 sections addressing employees and customers. Commitments are often hedged ('working to', 'striving to') though some are absolute ('can and will'). Shareholders and governance are absent; 'Trustworthy Computing' appears only as an unelaborated heading.
